data.body: SC-AMENDMENT-RECOMMENDATION (2026-05-20): SC-7 hook-path reference should be amended from 'test -x .claude/hooks/session-start-directory-size.sh' to 'test -x plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/session-start.sh && grep -q hook_directory_size_monitor plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/session-start.sh' (verify dispatcher executable AND sources directory-size hook function). Tag query ('ticket list --has-tag=directory-size-advisory') is preserved as written — task 0a30-4ef1-70dc-4479 will reconcile the implementation to emit that tag alongside dir:<path>. Rationale: the dispatcher pattern is the project's current standard for session-start hooks per HOOKS-REFERENCE.md; a direct-script install path would diverge from the rest of the hook surface. Reconciling the SC text (cheap, doc-only) is preferable to refactoring the working dispatcher implementation. IMPL-PLAN-REMEDIATION (2026-05-20): Added 2 new tasks — 86f9-34b9-0b81-4a26 (sc-7 self-use Probe-1 verification) and 0a30-4ef1-70dc-4479 (tag namespace + hook-path reconciliation).
